rows.note: This is the all-purpose noun for hidden knowledge that someone intends to keep hidden.

example.english: You can't tell anyone this secret.
example.traditional: 呢個秘密你唔可以同人講。
example.jyutping: ni1 go3 bei3 mat6 nei5 m4 ho2 ji5 tung4 jan4 gong2

rows.note: This is the all-purpose choice for something deliberately kept from other people, including a secret passage.

example.english: This is a secret, so don't tell anyone.
example.traditional: 呢件事係秘密，你唔好同人講。
example.jyutping: ni1 gin6 si6 hai6 bei3 mat6 nei5 m4 hou2 tung4 jan4 gong2

rows.note: Use this when the emphasis is that a place or thing is physically concealed or hard to notice rather than confidential.

example.english: This cave is a secret hideaway that people unfamiliar with the area can't find.
example.traditional: 呢個山洞好隱蔽，唔熟路嘅人搵唔到。
example.jyutping: ni1 go3 saan1 dung6 hou2 jan2 bai3 m4 suk6 lou6 ge3 jan4 wan2 m4 dou2
